title: Correct a record's text with adj amend
lead:
There is no way to fix a typo or a slightly wrong text in a record except
reject, withdraw or supersede. On S17, adj #2 (C24) keeps tradeoffs text that
repeats the recommendation.
findings_note: S17 dogfood friction (6), note on S20; C166

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S17 dogfood friction item 6. The owner chose its scope in C166.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/model/record.go`, `internal/model/transition.go`: a new history event for amend, and an Amend transition that changes only the C166 fields and records their old text.
- `internal/cli/amend.go`, `internal/commands/amend.go` (new): `adj amend ID` with flags for each field (names per C32); the usage text in `internal/cli/cli.go`.
- `internal/store/renumber.go`: store.IsStaleCopy (C163) treats title, context, options and recommendation as fields "only adj ask sets". After amend that is no longer true, so the edited-since rule must allow amend entries after the renumber entry the same way it allows decide and supersede, without letting a keeper be flagged as a stale copy.
- `internal/lint/lint.go`: the new event is valid.
- `internal/commands/ai.md`, `docs/json.md`: the new command and the new history event.
- Tests next to each changed file; extend the renumber and stale-copy tests in `internal/store`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestAmendTitle`, `TestAmendContext`, `TestAmendOptionSummary`, `TestAmendTradeoffs`, `TestAmendRationale`: each changes only that field, on an open and on a decided record, and appends one history entry dated by the clock that holds the old text.
- `TestAmendRefusesOtherFields`: there is no flag for status, decision, decided_by, IDs, links, key or tags, and amending an option label (as opposed to its summary) is refused.
- `TestAmendNoChange`: an amend that changes nothing is an error, and nothing is written.
- `TestAmendRationaleOnOpen`: amending the rationale of an open record (it has none) is refused.
- `TestStaleCopyAfterAmend` (store): a moved record amended after a crash is still recognised as the moved copy, and a keeper is still not flagged (both C163 cases).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
- One history entry per amend, whatever the number of fields changed.
- The old text must survive the file format: multi-line context and rationale round-trip through ReadFile and WriteFile.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `. scripts/env.sh && go test ./... && go vet ./... && test -z "$(gofmt -l cmd internal)"` passes.
- `adj lint` on a copy of `decisions/` reports nothing new.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body:
Worktree `.worktrees/s30` on branch `s30`. Commit and land on local main when
the owner asks; no AI attribution.
